name: Gästehaus Waltraud
beschreibung: Gästehaus Waltraud is a traditionally run inn in the center of Neustift im Stubaital. The location provides a short walk to the valley stations of the mountain lifts and the shops in the village. The rooms are functionally furnished and have a bathroom and WC. The amenities of the house include a breakfast room and a terrace. Breakfast is served directly in the house. The surroundings of the Stubaital are ideal for hiking and winter sports. Parking is available for guests.
